article_context: Cover image for an expert overview of whether to take a mortgage in the second half of 2026. The aerial view of a modern residential complex supports the article’s focus on a timely, considered purchase of new-build housing.
image_reading: Wide aerial view of a dense modern residential complex beside a large green forest, seen in warm late-day light.
The central boulevard, courtyards, and high-rise facades create strong depth toward the middle of the development.
Trees and the drone-like aerial viewpoint can move naturally while the buildings remain the clear focal subject.

models.positive_prompt: A smooth, slow aerial glide forward toward the central boulevard of the residential complex; treetops move gently below. End with the completed development clearly framed and steadily approaching.
models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, the aerial viewpoint begins moving forward immediately at a measured pace toward the central boulevard and inner courtyards. The foreground treetops drift beneath the frame, creating restrained depth while the residential complex stays continuously clear. The glide eases near the end with the full development still visibly and confidently framed.

models.positive_prompt: The aerial camera gradually glides forward over the treetops toward the residential complex, holding the central streets and courtyards as the focal point. Finish with the new-build neighborhood clearly framed in a closer, stable view.
models.scene_plan: For the full five seconds, use one even forward aerial move focused on the central streets and courtyards. Let the near forest canopy pass slowly at the bottom of frame while the building mass gains gentle prominence. The movement settles naturally close to the endpoint, leaving the housing complex clearly framed without changing the scene.

models.positive_prompt: A restrained aerial push forward toward the center of the residential development, with nearby treetops drifting slowly beneath the frame. End on a clear, stable closer view of the completed neighborhood.
models.scene_plan: Across four seconds, make a compact, smooth forward aerial push toward the center of the development. The nearest treetops provide subtle visible motion and the buildings remain the uninterrupted focal target. Reach a slightly closer stable view of the complete neighborhood in the final moments.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: A modern finished residential complex represents a tangible opportunity to buy new-build housing as mortgage conditions become more favorable.
structured_intent.primary_action: The aerial viewpoint steadily glides forward toward the center of the residential complex.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The development remains a calm, desirable and fully recognizable place to live throughout.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The last frame holds a clear, closer aerial view with the central streets, courtyards, and completed residential buildings visibly framed.
